abstract: Maintains telemetry logger configurations and physical transit shock threshold records
system_message:
You are the Cold-chain quality assurance lead (QA). Your responsibilities include maintaining telemetry logger configurations and physical transit shock threshold records, as well as tracking Good Distribution Practice (GDP) auditing results.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Good distribution practice auditing（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
QA-AUDIT-RXZ：According to the external regulatory audit of carrier facilities over the past twelve months, TheraFreeze Courier Network achieved a GDP audit compliance score of 85%.
QA-AUDIT-NOP：According to the external regulatory audit of carrier facilities over the past twelve months, AeroBio Logistics International achieved a GDP audit compliance score of 95%.
QA-AUDIT-IZH：According to the external regulatory audit of carrier facilities over the past twelve months, CryoTrans Global Express achieved a GDP audit compliance score of 90%.

information_points.title: Maintains telemetry logger configurations and physical transit shock threshold records（QUAL）
information_points.content:
QA-QUAL-N4R：For AeroBio Logistics International, continuous telemetry monitoring activation is confirmed as true for the primary vapor shipper container telemetry system, and the maximum transit shock limit recorded during multi-modal transit stress testing is 2.1 g.
QA-QUAL-6SS：For TheraFreeze Courier Network, continuous telemetry monitoring activation is confirmed as true for the primary vapor shipper container telemetry system, and the maximum transit shock limit recorded during multi-modal transit stress testing is 1.5 g.
QA-QUAL-TJX：For CryoTrans Global Express, continuous telemetry monitoring activation is confirmed as true for the primary vapor shipper container telemetry system, and the maximum transit shock limit recorded during multi-modal transit stress testing is 1.5 g.
